cells.scene: A traveler checks an open railway timetable with a station clerk who points helpfully at the relevant row.
A seated adult thoughtfully reviews a photograph from a recent journey, chin on hand and quiet reflective expression.
One cyclist easily climbs a hill on a geared bicycle while another struggles on a heavy ungeared bicycle; practical beneficial difference.
A powerful draft horse pulls a heavily loaded wagon smoothly, large strong muscles and sturdy build, no strain injury.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — consult (v.请教，查阅): A traveler checks an open railway timetable with a station clerk who points helpfully at the relevant row.
TOP RIGHT — reflect (v.细想): A seated adult thoughtfully reviews a photograph from a recent journey, chin on hand and quiet reflective expression.
BOTTOM LEFT — advantage (n.优势): One cyclist easily climbs a hill on a geared bicycle while another struggles on a heavy ungeared bicycle; practical beneficial difference.
BOTTOM RIGHT — mighty (a.强大的，有力的): A powerful draft horse pulls a heavily loaded wagon smoothly, large strong muscles and sturdy build, no strain injury.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: Course scenes and natural anatomy checked. Reflect shows quiet reflection; lodge shows lodging a complaint at a counter; chug has rhythmic steam puffs. All subjects have white margins inside their assigned crop.
